text: British American Tobacco is a publicly listed company: its primary listing is on the London Stock Exchange (ticker BATS), with a secondary listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and American Depositary Receipts traded on the New York Stock Exchange.
short: BAT's primary listing is on the London Stock Exchange.

source.name: BAT – Shareholder information: FAQ
source.quote: Our stock is listed and traded on three exchanges: Primary listing: London Stock Exchange under the ticker BATS
